scoring_justification: The six quantities are deterministic algebraic results from given inputs; the checker recomputes expected values from the same formulas and tolerances guard against rounding differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported reference values for the six ionization energies and reaction constant.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper text, discussion and figure captions: E_D ≈ 0.10 eV, E_A1 ≈ 0.60 eV, E_A2 ≈ 0.83 eV, acceptor_depth_A0 = 0.20 eV (E_g - A0), donor_depth_AB = 0.11 eV (A0 - B0), W0 = 10^8 s^-1.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are explicitly reported in the paper's conclusions and discussion.

outputs.description: The six headline quantities recomputed from the spectral data and physical constants: donor ionization energy E_D, acceptor ionization energies E_A1 and E_A2 from bound‑exciton lines, acceptor depth from the A0 zero‑phonon line, donor depth from the A0–B0 energy difference, and bound‑to‑bound reaction constant W0 from the time‑resolved peak shift.

output_contract.notes: All six quantities are computed directly from the provided peak energies and material constants using the neutral‑donor/neutral‑acceptor bound‑exciton relations and the donor‑acceptor pair reaction formula. No experimental data retrieval or fitting is required. The scoring checks each value against the hidden paper‑reported reference within a per‑quantity tolerance.

steps.description: Verify that each of the six reported quantities is within the allowed absolute tolerance of the paper's reference value.
